proposals.evidence: DEDR4198 gives Tamil piḷḷai and Kannada piḷḷe/piḷḷa child. Survey Irula piḷḷɛka child retains that stem with its ordinary nominal ending; the external Indo-Aryan comparisons in the article are not interpreted as a demonstrated immediate loan route. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR2896 attests Tamil/Malayalam cōḷam, Kannada/Kodagu/Tulu jōḷa, Telugu/Gondi jonna/jona and Gadaba jonnēl for great millet/jowar/maize. Survey forms retain the southern lateral versus central nasal branches, with Muthuvan -kam/-ku expansion. The source generic millet gloss is preserved; DEDR’s comparison with similar IA words (CDIAL10434) remains an origin/contact caveat, not an asserted loan route. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

Survey bare tā/taru and Urali tant- forms retain that give family and ordinary inflection. Perfect responses containing an unresolved additional stem are excluded. The paired elicitation gloss is retained even where this individual source record contains only the bare/imperative or inflected verb; no absent clause is reconstructed. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
